system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: prepares for a decision by querying the Cognition Layer for relevant tool/peer descriptions and receiving from the Elastic Memory Orchestrator a dynamically assembled, compressed history relevant to the current step
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only; cognition descriptions are updated and assembled per step.

env_context_strategy.note: Paper only; no repo in the evidence. The evidence has no task template or tool registry to check.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: whether the full detail ofRi is required, whether the summaryCi suffices, or whether the step's information can be temporarily omitted altogether
context_compaction.note: The EMO selector also omits steps, and MemFold does multi-step summarisation. Paper-only.

observation_format.note: No code; the observation conversion code is not available.

tool_call_format.note: No parser code in the evidence.

tool_count.note: The paper mentions web_search and Python execution, but there is no tool list.

edit_primitive.note: No tool definitions in the evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: The paper says tools are initially seeded with hand-written descriptions that later evolve, but no schema code is available.

protocol_standardization.note: No source or dependencies to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Inspired by the reasoning-and-acting paradigm [1], AutoAgent formalizes agent behavior as a repeating atomic decision cycle composed of three phases:Select,Execute, andUpdate.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: This on-the-fly decision-making allows the agent to dynamically replan, bypassing rigid workflows.
planning_granularity.note: The paper rejects a priori planning; no plan object is described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: we present AutoAgent, a self-evolving multi-agent framework
multi_agent_topology.note: Etic actions query peer agents; the exact default topology is unclear.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: such as querying a specialized peer for information, delegating a sub-task, or requesting verification
delegation_mechanism.note: Closest value; the mechanism is not specified.

human_in_loop.note: Fig. 2 lists Human-in-the-loop as an etic action, but no mechanism is described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the memory system maintains a dual representation: the raw, complete recordRi and its corresponding compressed summaryCi

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: the system continuously updates its cognitive models and skill library without external retraining
long_term_memory.note: The paper also describes episodic memories and evolved tool/peer descriptions.

self_verification.note: The intention-outcome analyzer serves cognition updates, not output verification.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: For RAG and standard tool-use tasks, the maximum number of reasoning/action steps is capped at 5.

cost_controls.note: EMO has a token budget for context size, not a spend cap.

tracing.evidence_quote: Each trajectory records, for a given task, the sequence of context states, the selected actions (emic or etic) with their parameters

eval_hooks.note: The paper evaluates on GAIA/HLE/ALFWorld, but there is no repo to check.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Empirical results across retrieval-augmented reasoning, tool-augmented agent benchmarks, and embodied task environments

open_source.note: The paper says code 'will be released'; no licence is in the evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: These include open-source models (DeepSeek-R1,QwQ-32B,Qwen3-30B-A3B) and closed-source models (GPT-4o,Gemini-3-Pro,Gemini-3-Pro-Thinking).

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: The codebase of AutoAgent will be released at https://github.com/vicFigure/AutoAgent.

first_release_date.note: Fallback to the paper v1 date; no tag information is available.

pinned_version.note: No repo commit is in the evidence; pinned to the paper version.

stars.note: No gh api data in the evidence.
